question.problem: In $2018$, Elena earned a salary of $$12,000.$ The following year, she earned $110%$ of the salary received in $2018.$ What was Elena's salary in $2019?$
question.worked_solution:
To solve this problem, we can use the formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is the amount of money Elena earned in $2018$, which is $$12,000.$ The percentage is $110%,$ and the part is the amount of money she earned in $2019.$

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
110%=110÷100=1.1
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =110%\times 12,000 \\  & =1.1\times 12,000 \\  & =13,200\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $110%$ of $12,000$ is $13,200.$ So, Elena earned $$13,200$ in $2019.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
110%=\frac{110}{100}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =110%\times 12,000 \\  & =\frac{110}{100}\times 12,000 \\  & =110\times \frac{12,000}{100} \\  & =110\times 120 \\  & =13,200\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $110%$ of $12,000$ is $13,200.$ So, Elena earned $$13,200$ in $2019.$
